# asset-sizes

Largest files in a build output folder, the total size and how many exceed a size limit.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | path | no | `dist/client/_build/assets` | Folder to measure, walked recursively |
| `--top` | int | no | `8` | Most files to list |
| `--limit` | int | no | `1024` | Size limit in KB |
| `--ext` | str | no | `""` | Only files ending in this suffix, such as .js |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run asset-sizes
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys files, total_kb, over, largest.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/asset-sizes.py` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
